mines.mine_notes: PFS (Feb 2023, Treasury Metals): after-tax NPV5% US$336M, IRR 25.4% at US$1,750/oz Au; 13-yr LOM; ~91,000 oz AuEq/yr avg. Updated FS studies underway in FY2025 (Mar 2025 update: after-tax NPV5% C$625M, IRR 41.1% at US$2,150/oz Au; 116,000 oz/yr first 7 yrs; FS in progress, engagement with First Nations, permitting). 25,000 m exploration drilling in 2025. No production at FY-end. Sold royalty over Goliath Gold Complex to Sprott Resource Streaming and Royalty (B) Corp. during FY2025; proceeds earmarked to deliver FS for Goliath Gold Complex.

FS (technical report dated Jan 11, 2022, inherited from predecessor): after-tax NPV5% C$328M, IRR 25.5%; ~100,000 oz Au/yr; cash cost US$773/oz; AISC US$849/oz. 100% owned via Signal transaction. Open-pit + underground resource: 2.58 Moz M&I @ 3.71 g/t (21.6 Mt). No production at FY-end. Nebari royalty sold over parts of Goldboro property in FY2025 (with buy-down option).

VMS polymetallic (gold, copper, zinc, silver) project on Prince of Wales Island, Alaska; 100% owned via Blackwolf transaction. Includes site plant and equipment. Exploration-stage; no MRE figures disclosed in FY2025 MD&A.

notes: Gold developer formed from predecessor transactions (Blackwolf — Niblack; Signal — Goldboro) with Goliath Gold Complex (Goliath, Goldlund, Miller deposits, northwestern Ontario), Goldboro (southeast Nova Scotia), Niblack (Alaska), and Weebigee (JV with S2 Minerals, northwestern Ontario, exploration-stage). FY2025 = year ended December 31, 2025; 40-F filed ~Mar 24, 2026. No production at any project; no revenue. Resource figures are per the projects' published technical reports (Goliath 2023 PFS MRE; Goldboro Jan 2022 FS), not restated in the FY2025 MD&A — flagged as sourced from those reports. Head office 20 Adelaide St, Suite 401, Toronto.
